---
title: "Library - Equipment"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| include: false

# Load shared utilities
source("_common.R")

# Connect to database and load tables
con <- get_db_connection("../../asset/demonax-test.sqlite")
tables <- load_item_tables(con)
quests <- dbReadTable(con, "quests")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# Get available item images to avoid 404s
available_items <- get_available_item_images("../../asset/img/item")

# Define equipment attribute configuration (equipment-specific)
equipment_attr_config <- list(
  "BodyPosition" = list(output_name = "body_position", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "ArmorValue" = list(output_name = "armor_value", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "DamageIncrease" = list(output_name = "damage_increase", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "DamageReduction" = list(output_name = "damage_reduction", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "ProtectionDamageTypes" = list(output_name = "protection_damage_types", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "WeaknessDamageTypes" = list(output_name = "weakness_damage_types", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "SkillModification" = list(output_name = "skill_modification", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "SkillNumber" = list(output_name = "skill_number", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "MinimumLevel" = list(output_name = "minimum_level", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "Weight" = list(output_name = "weight", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "Professions" = list(output_name = "professions", type = "integer", default = NA_integer_),
  "CriticalHitChance" = list(output_name = "critical_hit_chance", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "CriticalHitIncrease" = list(output_name = "critical_hit_increase", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "ShieldDefendValue" = list(output_name = "shield_defend_value", type = "integer", default = 0L),
  "Capacity" = list(output_name = "capacity", type = "integer", default = 0L)
)

# Process items with parsed attributes and extracted columns
items <- tables$items |>
  add_parsed_attrs() |>
  add_extracted_attrs(equipment_attr_config)

# Prepare lookup tables using shared functions
loot_lookup <- create_loot_lookup(tables$item_loot_sources, tables$creatures)
sell_lookup <- create_sell_lookup(tables$item_prices, tables$npc_locations)
buy_lookup <- create_buy_lookup(tables$item_prices, tables$npc_locations)
quest_lookup <- create_quest_lookup(quests)

# Prepare all equipment data once (do joins and mutations only once)
equipment_data <- items |>
  left_join(loot_lookup, by = c("type_id" = "item_id")) |>
  left_join(sell_lookup, by = c("type_id" = "item_id")) |>
  left_join(buy_lookup, by = c("type_id" = "item_id")) |>
  mutate(
    image = ifelse(
      type_id %in% available_items,
      paste0('<img src="../../asset/img/item/', type_id, '.png" width="32" height="32">'),
      '<span  style="display:inline-block;width:32px;height:32px;background:#e0e0e0;border-radius:3px;"></span>'
    ),
    profession = decode_professions(professions),
    level = ifelse(
      minimum_level > 0,
      minimum_level,
      ""
    ),
    skill = case_when(
      is.na(skill_number) ~ "",
      skill_number == 1 ~ paste0("Magic level +", skill_modification),
      skill_number == 4 ~ paste0("Speed +", skill_modification),
      skill_number == 6 ~ paste0("Shielding +", skill_modification),
      skill_number == 7 ~ paste0("Distance fighting +", skill_modification),
      skill_number == 8 ~ paste0("Sword fighting +", skill_modification),
      skill_number == 9 ~ paste0("Club fighting +", skill_modification),
      skill_number == 10 ~ paste0("Axe fighting +", skill_modification),
      skill_number == 14 ~ paste0("Slightly faster regeneration +", skill_modification),
      skill_number == 16 ~ paste0("Invisibility +", skill_modification),
      skill_number == 20 ~ paste0("Protection vs drunkenness +", skill_modification),
      skill_number == 21 ~ paste0("Mana shield +", skill_modification),
      TRUE ~ ""  # default
    ),
    critical = ifelse(
      critical_hit_chance > 0,
      paste0(critical_hit_chance, "% / ", critical_hit_increase, "%"),
      ""
    ),
    defense = shield_defend_value,
    protection = ifelse(
      protection_damage_types > 0,
      paste0(
        decode_damage_types(protection_damage_types),
        " -", damage_reduction, "%"
        ),
      ""
    ),
    weakness = ifelse(
      weakness_damage_types > 0,
      paste0(
        decode_damage_types(weakness_damage_types),
        " +", damage_increase, "%"
      ),
      ""
    ),
    description = ifelse(!is.na(description), description, ""),
    sell_to = ifelse(!is.na(sell_npc), paste0(sell_npc_html, " (", sell_price, " gp)"), ""),
    buy_from = ifelse(!is.na(buy_npc), paste0(buy_npc_html, " (", buy_price, " gp)"), ""),
    rewarded_from_html = sapply(rewarded_from, function(x) convert_quest_rewards_to_links(x, quest_lookup))
  )
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Helmets

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

helmets <- equipment_data |>
  filter(body_position == 1) |>
  select(
    Image = image,
    Name = name,
    Armor = armor_value,
    Weight = weight,
    Level = level,
    Profession = profession,
    Skill = skill,
    Protection = protection,
    Weakness = weakness,
    Critical = critical,
    Description = description,
    `Lootable from` = lootable_from,
    `Rewarded from` = rewarded_from_html,
    `Sell to` = sell_to,
    `Buy from` = buy_from
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(Armor))

create_datatable(helmets, image_col_width = "32px")
```
